description: The file defines the CustomerReward controller class within the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for displaying, saving, and generating reports about customer reward points. It includes methods for rendering the report page, saving configurations, fetching report data, and paginating results.

classes.name: CustomerReward
classes.description: Controller class managing customer reward point reports in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering report pages, saving configurations, and fetching customer reward data with pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, breadcrumbs, and common layout components; renders the report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of configuration settings related to customer reward report, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer reward report page with data fetched via getReport().

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of customer reward data, primarily for AJAX or partial updates.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches filtered, paginated customer reward data, builds pagination URLs, and renders the reward list view.
